how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:shaman-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:63:obj:0: Defeat the Corrupt Manifestation of Water and place the Corrupted Manifestation's Bracers along with the Remaining Drops of Purest Water on the Brazier of Everfount in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:63:details:0: Along the coast of Silverpine, west of the Sepulcher, you will find a shrine that has become tainted by the plague. The spirits there no longer speak to our people and it will be up to you to defeat the manifestation and cleanse the pool.
rows.quest:63:details:1: BTake the elemental's bracers, along with the remaining drops of Brine's potion, and place them on the brazier. The ritual should be enough to summon a pure spirit for you to communicate with.
rows.quest:63:details:2: BBring me proof the task is done, and I will reward you with your totem.
rows.quest:63:completion:0: You place the bracers atop the brazier and then pour the remaining drops of Brine's potion into the flame. The drops crackle as they hit the flame and you begin to incant the simple words Islen taught you....
rows.quest:96:obj:0: Bring the Shard of Water to Islen Waterseer in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:96:details:0: Take shard. Take shard and give life.
rows.quest:96:details:1: BGive life and understand. Understand water is life... corruption stops life.
rows.quest:96:details:2: BYou protect and give life with water's power.
rows.quest:96:completion:0: This is the proof I asked for. You've done well, ⟦1⟧.
rows.quest:96:completion:1: BI am pleased to be the first to congratulate you and give you this... your water totem.
rows.quest:96:completion:2: BUse it well, and good luck.
rows.quest:96:completion:3: BYour next test will not be for some time, so learn your lessons well. Pure water will not only give life back to those who are injured, but can have many other effects. I suggest you seek out a shaman trainer when you have the time. They might have other spells for you to learn.
rows.quest:100:obj:0: Speak to the Minor Manifestation of Water in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:100:details:0: Light explodes as you finish the incantation. The sounds of the water drops hitting the flame have died down and your senses are overcome as the corrupt spirits around you are destroyed.
rows.quest:100:completion:0: Thanks to you. Thanks to the shamans.
rows.quest:100:completion:1: BCorruption ebbs but life continues to wane. Up to shamans to protect life.
rows.quest:220:obj:0: Bring the Vial of Purest Water to Islen Waterseer in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:220:details:0: Islen will have one more task for you before rewarding you with your next totem. The vial of water I've given you is necessary for whatever that task is.
rows.quest:220:details:1: BGo now and find her. We shall meet again some day.
rows.quest:220:completion:0: Ah, a vial of water created and blessed by Brine, and gathered by you, no less.
rows.quest:220:completion:1: BThe liquid in this vial will be key in creating a sapta for you, but also used in one other task.
rows.quest:220:completion:2: BThe sapta I create for you should be used to see the water spirits at the shrine in ⟦E1⟧, south of the ⟦E3⟧. The remaining drops, well, the remaining drops I will tell you about if you feel you are ready.
rows.quest:220:completion:3: BAre you prepared for one more journey, ⟦2⟧?
rows.quest:1516:obj:0: Bring 2 Felstalker Hooves to Canaga Earthcaller in the Valley of Trials.
rows.quest:1516:details:0: The time is now, young ⟦3⟧. You've grown strong and your spirit endures like the earth. Following the shaman's path shows you have wisdom before even proving yourself.
rows.quest:1516:details:1: BThe element of earth will guide your destiny, becoming part of you if you are ready. But you must stand before the earth itself. If you are ready, then you will see things only shaman know of.
rows.quest:1516:details:2: BSeek out the Felstalkers to the north, and take from them two of their hooves. Return to me then, and we shall speak more of your future.⟦4⟧
rows.quest:1516:completion:0: Excellent. Your success shows that you are prepared.
rows.quest:1516:completion:1: BOf all the elements, earth represents the foundation of all things. It is your strength, your stamina, and your patience. Earth will protect you, but only if shown the proper respect. Like the other elements, even earth can be fickle. Earth is the basis for life, and by observing its laws, you will gain greater wisdom. Never forget the secrets earth shares with you.
rows.quest:1516:completion:2: BI shall make a sapta for you now, and by accepting it, you will realize your path.
rows.quest:1517:obj:0: Find Spirit Rock and drink the Earth Sapta.
rows.quest:1517:details:0: A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the strong willed to see the elements as no one else can. Your spirit will be connected to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few shaman know the recipe.
rows.quest:1517:details:1: BThe sapta is always drunk in a holy place, and never anywhere else--remember that.
rows.quest:1517:details:2: BSeek out Spirit Rock southwest of here--it is found at the end of the Hidden Path. Drink your sapta there, and... well, you shall see.
rows.quest:1517:completion:0: Ah... ⟦5⟧... pleased is the earth to have you here.
rows.quest:1517:completion:1: BBound together in body and spirit, you will go forward knowing that the mountains are your strength; the plains, your patience; and the world itself your essence.
rows.quest:1517:completion:2: BStanding before the earth humbly is all that is required of you for you to pass this rite. But the others are not as passive. They may be chaotic and often violent, but such is the nature of the elements. Dual natures opposing one another, you must come to learn these things intricately.
rows.quest:1518:obj:0: Bring the Rough Quartz to Canaga Earthcaller in the Valley of Trials.
rows.quest:1518:details:0: Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Canaga Earthcaller as proof of our meeting. He will craft a totem for you, and this pebble will be the heart of it. As small as it may seem, you will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest of things can outlast many others.
rows.quest:1518:details:1: BBe patient, ⟦6⟧. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks of you. In the end, you shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect you.
rows.quest:1518:completion:1: BThe totem I will craft for you is more than a symbol of your status among ⟦7⟧--it has abilities beyond that. One use of the totem is as a focus for spells. Those spells are tied to the earth, and as you earn greater and greater wisdom, more of the earth's abilities will be made accessible to you.
rows.quest:1518:completion:2: BThe trainers will know when you are ready for greater knowledge.
rows.quest:1518:completion:3: BBut for now, take this earth totem, and a scroll to teach you your first ability.
rows.quest:1519:obj:0: Bring 2 applications of Ritual Salve to Seer Ravenfeather in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1519:details:0: The time has come, young ⟦8⟧. Your body ages and grows strong, and your spirit endures like the earth. I see it within you-you have wisdom already.
rows.quest:1519:details:1: BThe earth guides our people, and it speaks to us, as it will to you in time. But you must be tested. If you are ready, then you shall see things only our kind know of.
rows.quest:1519:details:2: BSeek out the Bristleback shamans in their ravine to the east, and take from them a salve they use in their rituals. Return to me only when you have enough for your own potion.
rows.quest:1519:completion:0: Good, ⟦9⟧. Your return here signifies that you are indeed prepared for the next step.
rows.quest:1519:completion:1: BOf all the elements, earth represents the foundation of all things. It is your strength, your stamina, and your patience. The Earth Mother will protect you, but only if you show her proper respect. She is the basis for life, and by observing her laws, you will gain a greater wisdom. Never forget the secrets she shares with you.
rows.quest:1519:completion:2: BI shall make your sapta for you now, and by accepting it, a new path will open before you.
rows.quest:1520:obj:0: Find Kodo Rock and drink the Earth Sapta.
rows.quest:1520:details:0: A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the open minded to see the elements as no one has seen them before. Your spirit will forever be tied to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few of our kind know the secrets of its creation.
rows.quest:1520:details:1: BThe sapta is always imbibed in a holy place, and never anywhere else.
rows.quest:1520:details:2: BSeek out the shaman shrine to the east of here and drink of the sapta.
rows.quest:1520:completion:0: Ah... ⟦10⟧... pleased is the earth to have you here.
rows.quest:1520:completion:1: BBound together in body and spirit, you will go forward knowing that the mountains are your strength; the plains, your patience; and the world itself your essence.
rows.quest:1520:completion:2: BStanding before the earth humbly is all that is required of you for you to pass this rite. But the others are not as passive. They may be chaotic and often violent, but such is the nature of the elements. Dual natures opposing one another, you must come to learn these things intricately.
rows.quest:1521:obj:0: Bring the Rough Quartz to Seer Ravenfeather in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1521:details:0: Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Seer Ravenfeather as proof of our meeting. She will craft a totem for you, and this pebble will be the heart of it. As small as it may seem, you will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest of things can outlast mountains.
rows.quest:1521:details:1: BBe patient, ⟦11⟧. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks of you. In the end, you shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect you.
rows.quest:1521:completion:1: BThe totem I will craft for you is more than a symbol--it has abilities beyond that. One use of the totem is a focus for spells. Those spells are tied to the earth, and as you earn greater and greater wisdom, more of the earth's abilities will be made accessible to you. Trainers found throughout ⟦E5⟧ will know when you are ready for greater knowledge and will let you know as much when you visit them.
rows.quest:1521:completion:2: BBut for now, take this earth totem, and a scroll to teach you your first ability.
rows.quest:1522:details:0: ⟦E6⟧ be witcha, mon. I see you be strong in da ways of earth already, an' me tinkin' you be ready to talk to Kranal.
rows.quest:1522:details:1: BKranal live north of da Crossroads in da ⟦E2⟧. He be strong in da ways of da elements and can teach ya da ways of fire... if you tink you be ready.
rows.quest:1522:details:2: BHe be easy ta find, just don' go too far--ya go too far an' ya find yerself in da elves' lands.
rows.quest:1522:completion:0: Hmmm, Searn sent you to me, did he?
rows.quest:1522:completion:1: BWell then, Searn could always be trusted, so that must mean you're ready to take part of the next sapta--the sapta of fire.
rows.quest:1522:completion:2: BI see it in your eyes already, the burning, the desire. You've tasted power, and now you're ready for more of it. Patience, ⟦12⟧. Remember what earth taught you. Power and destruction will come easily, but you must still know when to stay your hand.
rows.quest:1523:details:0: Long has it been since you were last tested, ⟦13⟧. You have shown patience thus far in your studies, but the time has come for you to learn more. The time has come for you to learn about destruction... and chaos. The element of fire is yours for the understanding, if you're prepared to pay for it.
rows.quest:1523:details:1: BSeek out Kranal Fiss in the ⟦E2⟧. He lives in a small dwelling north of the Crossroads, but be mindful, if you've reached the night elf lands, you've gone too far.
rows.quest:1523:completion:0: Hmmm, Narm sent you to me, did he?
rows.quest:1523:completion:1: BWell then, Narm could always be trusted, so that must mean you're ready to take part of the next sapta--the sapta of fire.
rows.quest:1523:completion:2: BI see it in your eyes already, the burning, the desire. You've tasted power, and now you're ready for more of it. Patience, ⟦14⟧. Remember what earth taught you. Power and destruction will come easily, but you must still know when to stay your hand.
rows.quest:1524:obj:0: Bring the Torch of the Dormant Flame to Telf Joolam in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:1524:details:0: You are powerful enough to wield the totem of fire, but that does not mean you are ready.
rows.quest:1524:details:1: BAlong the Southfury River in ⟦E7⟧, before the Great Sea, lies a hidden trail to one of the highest peaks in the land. Find your way to the top and you shall find one of our holy shrines watched over by Telf Joolam--the Shrine of the Dormant Flame.
rows.quest:1524:details:2: BTake this torch to him--it marks that you attempt to tame fire. Return it to me aflame by the brazier at the shrine and I will see you are given the totem of fire.
rows.quest:1524:completion:0: Ah, my mistake, ⟦15⟧. I apologize. I did not realize you possessed the Torch. I am pleased to make your acquaintance.
rows.quest:1524:completion:1: BMany adventurers find their way here while looking for lost treasure or the promise of mystical creatures to slay, only to be turned away from a seemingly empty shrine. But we know the truth, do we not, ⟦16⟧?
rows.quest:1524:completion:2: BThis shrine holds a greater secret from the mundane members of the ⟦E8⟧. To us, it is sacred.
rows.quest:1525:obj:0: Bring 1 ⟦E6⟧ Tar and 1 Reagent Pouch to Telf Joolam in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:1525:details:0: But you did not come here for a history lesson, did you? You came for the Eternal Flame and fire totem.
rows.quest:1525:details:1: BThe first step is to create a sapta and bind you to the flame.
rows.quest:1525:details:2: BI can create the fire sapta for you if you bring me two items. The first is fire tar, a simple item usually carried by Razormane spellcasters in eastern ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1525:details:3: BThe second item will be more dangerous: a reagent pouch from one of the cultists of the Burning Blade. You can find them in a cave above the ravines northeast of Razor Hill.
rows.quest:1525:completion:1: BFire is more than chaos and destruction--do well to remember that. It is also about life, and creation. All things are tied together in such a way. Forces oppose one another, but at the same time, one cannot exist without the other. Both extinguish one another, but also give one another meaning. Always remember this.
rows.quest:1525:completion:2: BUsing different types of magic in conjunction with one another will show not only true skill, but great wisdom.
rows.quest:1526:obj:0: Defeat the Minor Manifestation of ⟦E6⟧, and place the Glowing Ember in the brazier atop the Shrine of Eternal Flame.
rows.quest:1526:details:0: The fire sapta is finished. The time has come for you to face the flame. Use the sapta at the shrine and head to the top of the mountain to face the manifestation there. He will not attack until you are ready, but he will realize you are able to see him.
rows.quest:1526:details:1: BStrike him down swiftly, ⟦18⟧, for he shall only grow in power the longer you take to slay him. Once he is defeated, place his glowing embers within the brazier and light the torch.
rows.quest:1526:completion:0: A white hot flame ignites within the bowl as you place the ember within. You can feel the magical effects of the sapta coursing through your body and the fire dances rhythmically before you.
rows.quest:1526:completion:1: BYou place the top of the torch within the basin, and it immediately catches on fire.
rows.quest:1527:obj:0: Bring the Torch of Eternal Flame to Kranal Fiss in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1527:details:0: Torch firmly in hand, you turn away from the brazier and look out over ⟦E7⟧. You feel an excitement tugging at your spirit as the wind picks up and forces the flame to dance violently.
rows.quest:1527:details:1: BYou start off down the path back to the ⟦E2⟧ in search of Kranal Fiss.
rows.quest:1527:completion:0: Your spirit burns brighter than any torch I've ever seen, ⟦19⟧, and for that, you should be proud.
rows.quest:1527:completion:1: BIf you continue down this path, the elements will be yours to command, and our brethren will look to you for guidance and wisdom. Let me be the first to congratulate you and present to you your newest totem.
rows.quest:1528:details:0: Water be in ya future, mon. I see you be strong in da ways of fire already, an' me tinkin' you be ready to talk to Islen.
rows.quest:1528:details:1: BIslen live along the coast of da ⟦E2⟧. If ya head south along the Southfury River, ya canna miss her--look fer da big shark! She be strong in da ways of da elements and can teach ya da ways of water... if you tink you be ready.
rows.quest:1528:details:2: BShe be easy ta find, just don' go too far south--she be jus' beyond Ratchet.
rows.quest:1528:completion:0: The wind approaches you quickly from the horizon; the earth is steady beneath your feet; and your spirit is already warmed by fire--I would say it is time for you to learn about the purity of water.
rows.quest:1528:completion:1: BYour path has led you this far, and your spirit will give you the strength to carry on even further. But the first step is yours to take.
rows.quest:1529:details:0: Long has it been since you were last tested, ⟦20⟧. You have shown patience thus far in your studies, but the time has come for you to learn more. The time has come for you to learn about the purity of water.
rows.quest:1529:details:1: BSeek out Islen Waterseer in the ⟦E2⟧. She is along the eastern coast, south of the Southfury River and Ratchet. You will find her there at her fishing hut. Good luck to you, ⟦21⟧.
rows.quest:1529:completion:0: The wind approaches you quickly from the horizon; the earth is steady beneath your feet; and your spirit is already warmed by fire--I would say it is time for you to learn about the purity of water.
rows.quest:1529:completion:1: BYour path has led you this far, and your spirit will give you the strength to carry on even further. But the first step is yours to take.
rows.quest:1530:details:0: If there is one lesson you must learn of water, it is this: water means rebirth.
rows.quest:1530:details:1: BIts power flows, erodes, and makes clean all manner of things. You will find its ability to heal and replenish incomparable, but only when it is pure.
rows.quest:1530:details:2: BWhen you understand that water, when polluted, can devastate all that it touches, you will appreciate how vital a resource it is.
rows.quest:1530:details:3: BIf you wish the water sapta, find Brine deep in Southern ⟦E2⟧. Her home is continually molested by the quilboar there.
rows.quest:1530:completion:1: BMmm. I have a feeling I know what you're going to ask me: what would possess someone to live out here in the deepest part of the ⟦E2⟧, the threat of quilboar all around, and no protection? Well, we all have our reasons to justify why we act the way we do. The real question is, what brings a lowly ⟦22⟧ to the deepest reaches of the ⟦E2⟧ to speak to a woman who obviously has no concern for her own well-being?
rows.quest:1530:completion:2: BI'm willing to bet we both know the answer to that.
rows.quest:1531:details:0: You be makin' headway now, mon. Your be ready to prove yerself worthy of the air totem, but first, ya must fin' Prate Cloudseer in ⟦E9⟧. She be willin' ta tell ya how to get yer air totem if ya treat her wit enough respect.
rows.quest:1531:details:1: BHead south through the ⟦E2⟧, and after ya reach ⟦E9⟧, head east. You'll find her hiddin' in a hole wit' her boyfriend--haha, don' tell her I be dissin' her none--she not take it too kindly.
rows.quest:1531:completion:0: For the time being. I shall give you what you need to focus your spells and to call upon the spirits of air. Take this totem, and when you are ready, train with me some more.
rows.quest:1532:details:0: The winds of ⟦E5⟧ rush to meet you and you shall be counted among some of our most powerful ⟦23⟧. I am proud to see you have come this far and have such a promising future.
rows.quest:1532:details:1: BThe element of air is a difficult one to control, but I have faith that your skills will overcome any obstacles that are placed in front of you.
rows.quest:1532:details:2: BHead to the very south of the ⟦E2⟧, and enter ⟦E9⟧. It is there, far to the east, that you will find Prate Cloudseer. She will teach you more.
rows.quest:1532:completion:0: For the time being. I shall give you what you need to focus your spells and to call upon the spirits of air. Take this totem, and when you are ready, train with me some more.
rows.quest:1534:obj:0: Fill the Empty Blue Waterskin at the Ruins of Stardust in ⟦E10⟧ and return to Brine in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1534:details:0: Take this waterskin and head deep into the lush forest the night elves call ⟦E10⟧. It is to the far north of the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1534:details:1: BOnce you've entered the forest, travel west. Along the mountains that separate Stonetalon and ⟦E10⟧, and beyond Lake Mystral, you will find a holy place: the Ruins of Stardust. At the center of the lake you will find a small fountain.
rows.quest:1534:details:2: BBring me a sample of the fountain's water. It will be the final component you'll need before I send you back to Islen.
rows.quest:1534:completion:0: Wonderful, ⟦24⟧. With all three samples gathered, I can create for you a vial of the purest water any living creature will find. It will be used in the next steps of your rite of passage.
rows.quest:1534:completion:1: BI am pleased to count you among our kind, ⟦25⟧. You do all ⟦26⟧ proud, and I look forward to hearing about your exploits in the future.
rows.quest:1535:obj:0: Fill the Empty Brown Waterskin at the watering hole below Brine's hut and return it to her in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1535:details:0: To find understanding and gain the sapta from me, you must seek out only the purest forms of water. As you fetch the samples for me, take note of your surroundings. Be aware of the creatures that rely on the water, that protect it. See how it affects forests and deserts. Witness how the very substance that sustains life will force creatures to take lives.
rows.quest:1535:details:1: BWe shall start with a simple task: down below my hut there is a pond of the precious liquid. Fill this skin with it and return to me.
rows.quest:1535:completion:0: I thought some bloodshed might ensue if you tried to take water from the pool. It is a pity the quilboar do not realize that all living things are tied together; that their greed only perpetuates the pain and suffering of their people. How much could they accomplish if they were to put their differences aside and their clans came together.
rows.quest:1535:completion:1: BAgain, a pity, but more than likely a boon for the other races of the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1536:obj:0: Fill the Empty Red Waterskin at the well in Tarren Mill and return to Brine in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1536:details:0: Long ago I followed some companions into the ⟦E11⟧. We defended ourselves from some tenacious humans who make their home there and we found ourselves in a small town the ⟦E12⟧ had taken over: Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:1536:details:1: BIt was there I found a most peculiar thing: in the center of town was a small well of fresh spring water. I'm not sure the plagued citizens of the town even realize its value--it's a small holy vestige in an unhallowed sea.
rows.quest:1536:details:2: BBring me a sample of that water in this waterskin.
rows.quest:1536:completion:0: This is good, ⟦27⟧. You're dedicated to the task at hand and have the ability to seek out that which is needed.
rows.quest:1536:completion:1: BOne more sample is all I need to create the reagent needed for your sapta. Islen will be pleased as well.
rows.quest:2983:details:0: It's been some time since you were tested last, ⟦28⟧. You've been patient thus far in your studies, but it's time for you to learn about greater powers... it's time you learn real power. The element of fire is yours if you're prepared to pay for it.
rows.quest:2983:details:1: BSeek out Kranal Fiss in the ⟦E2⟧. He lives in a small dwelling north of the Crossroads, but be mindful, if you've reached the blasted night elf lands, you've gone way too far.
rows.quest:2983:completion:0: Hmmm, Swart sent you to me, did he?

rows.quest:2984:completion:0: Hmmm, Narm sent you to me, did he?⟦31⟧bWell then, Narm could always be trusted, so that must mean you're ready to take part of the next sapta--the sapta of fire.
rows.quest:2984:completion:1: BI see it in your eyes already, the burning, the desire. You've tasted power, and now you're ready for more of it. Patience, ⟦32⟧. Remember what earth taught you. Power and destruction will come easily, but you must still know when to stay your hand.
rows.quest:2985:details:0: You look ready for your next test, ⟦33⟧. You've been patient in your studies, but the time has come for you to learn more. The time has come for you to learn about the purity of water.
rows.quest:2985:details:1: BSeek out Islen Waterseer in the ⟦E2⟧. She is along the eastern coast, south of the Southfury River and Ratchet. You will find her there at her fishing hut. Good luck to you, ⟦34⟧.
rows.quest:2985:completion:0: The wind approaches you quickly from the horizon; the earth is steady beneath your feet; and your spirit is already warmed by fire--I would say it is time for you to learn about the purity of water.
rows.quest:2985:completion:1: BYour path has led you this far, and your spirit will give you the strength to carry on even further. But the first step is yours to take.
rows.quest:2986:details:0: Long has it been since you were last tested, ⟦35⟧. You have shown patience thus far in your studies, but the time has come for you to learn more. The time has come for you to learn about the purity of water.
rows.quest:2986:details:1: BSeek out Islen Waterseer in the ⟦E2⟧. She is along the eastern coast, south of the Southfury River and Ratchet. You will find her there at her fishing hut. Good luck to you, ⟦36⟧.
rows.quest:2986:completion:0: The wind approaches you quickly from the horizon; the earth is steady beneath your feet; and your spirit is already warmed by fire--I would say it is time for you to learn about the purity of water.
rows.quest:2986:completion:1: BYour path has led you this far, and your spirit will give you the strength to carry on even further. But the first step is yours to take.
rows.quest:3084:obj:0: Speak to Shikrik in the Valley of Trials.
rows.quest:3084:details:0: Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, ⟦37⟧.
rows.quest:3084:details:1: BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the shaman trainer Shikrik. She would have words with you when you're ready.
rows.quest:3084:completion:0: As you probably know, the elements give us our power. ⟦E6⟧, earth, water and air--these are our tools.
rows.quest:3084:completion:1: BOur strength comes from the spirits of our ancestors. We are the leaders of our people. Like Thrall is to the ⟦E8⟧, so shall we be to the villages and towns we visit. They will look to us for wisdom and protection. To be better prepared, you must train often. When you feel you've gained more power, come to me and I shall teach you what I can.
rows.quest:3089:obj:0: Read the Rune-Inscribed Parchment and speak to Shikrik in the Valley of Trials.
rows.quest:3089:details:0: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, ⟦38⟧.
rows.quest:3089:details:1: BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the shaman trainer Shikrik. She would have words with you when you're ready.
rows.quest:3089:completion:0: You will be the conduit in which our ancestors communicate. You will have the power of the elements at your beck and call. Sundering your enemies will be child's play; healing your allies as easy as breathing. Keep these things in mind as you face new challenges, and come back to me as often as you'd like. I will remain here to teach you new spells and set you on the correct path when you are ready.
rows.quest:3093:obj:0: Read the Rune-Inscribed Note and speak to Meela Dawnstrider in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:3093:details:0: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, ⟦39⟧. I believe she was sent by the shaman trainer Meela. If this note is from Meela, I wouldn't take long in reading it's contents.⟦40⟧
rows.quest:3093:completion:0: We will meet many times in the days to come. Each time you will hopefully leave my company a little more powerful... a little more prepared. Like the Eternal Flame, your spirit will burn bright and hot.
rows.quest:3093:completion:1: BGo now, ⟦41⟧. Go and test yourself. I will be here for you when you need.
rows.quest:7667:obj:0: If you are interested in helping Sagorne Crestrider in ⟦E13⟧'s Valley of Wisdom, bring him an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond.
rows.quest:7667:details:0: ⟦42⟧, there is a pressing matter I hope you can help with... both materially and spiritually. Allow me to explain.
rows.quest:7667:details:1: BWithin the depths of the Scholomance in Lordaeron is a chamber called the Great Ossuary. I need to complete a device that would pierce the shadows of this horrid room. To finish what I have started, I need two diamonds: an Azerothian and a Pristine Black. These are not trivial items, I know - I just don't have the resources myself.
rows.quest:7667:details:2: BCould you provide me with one of each?
rows.quest:7667:completion:0: Your generosity is unrivaled, ⟦43⟧. I thank you for your kindness.
rows.quest:7667:completion:1: BI will be able to finish my divination scryer now, and I should be able to fashion more without further need of diamonds... perhaps you would be interested in helping me in its use? It is for a most important task, I assure you... one that left unchecked could spell unmitigated disaster for the spirit realm!
rows.quest:8258:obj:0: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth spirits you must fight. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver; defeat him.
rows.quest:8258:obj:1: BBring Darkreaver's Head to Sagorne Creststrider in the Valley of Wisdom, ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:8258:details:0: Death Knight Darkreaver lords over the Great Ossuary in the Scholomance. He threatens to twist the spirit realm to do his own bidding, and he must be stopped! This is where the scryer you helped make comes into play.
rows.quest:8258:details:1: BUse the divination scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement to call forth Darkreaver's spirit minions. Defeat the spirits and the death knight himself will appear. ⟦44⟧, bring me his head! Only his demise will reverse the damage done to the spirit realm!
rows.quest:8258:completion:0: This is a victory to savor, ⟦45⟧! The demise of Darkreaver should restore the fragile fetters that anchor the spirit realm.
rows.quest:8258:completion:1: BYou have far exceeded what was asked of you, even when you had no notion of reward or compensation. You are truly a ⟦46⟧ of worth, my friend.
rows.quest:8258:completion:2: BI know that acting to preserve the spirit realm should be thanks enough, but please - accept this simple gift with my thanks.
rows.quest:8410:obj:0: Collect a sample of air, fire, earth and water for Bath'rah the Windwatcher.
rows.quest:8410:details:0: Bath'rah the Windwatcher has sent out a summons for a shaman of your wisdom. He requests you bring a sample of each of the elements to show you are ready.
rows.quest:8410:details:1: BTo find Bath'rah, go to the river east of Tarren Mill. Follow the river north until you come across the ruins where Bath'rah resides.
rows.quest:8410:completion:0: Excellent, mon. Now we be talkin'.
rows.quest:8411:obj:0: Bring the elements earth, air, fire and water to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.
rows.quest:8411:details:0: Welcome, ⟦47⟧. You bring me the elements and then we do the talkin'.
rows.quest:8411:details:1: BThe fire, the air, the water, and the earth I be needin' before I trust ya, mon. I gots to know you be knowledgeable.
rows.quest:8411:completion:0: These be the elements I need. Now we talk.
rows.quest:8412:obj:0: Bring the pieces for the spirit totem to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.
rows.quest:8412:details:0: The ⟦E14⟧ of this place don't be likin' me any more.
rows.quest:8412:details:1: BYou know about the totems more than any, and I be needin' a spirit totem to protect me. We already got the elements, now we need somethin' more with more nature. More primal.
rows.quest:8412:details:2: BIn the ⟦E15⟧ you can kill bears for claws and spiders for their eyes. The carrion birds eat everything, so they might have either one.
rows.quest:8412:completion:0: Great, mon! Let's try it out...
rows.quest:8413:obj:0: Bring the voodoo feathers to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.
rows.quest:8413:details:0: The spirit totem just isn't enough. We be needin' some voodoo magic to make it work jus' right.
rows.quest:8413:details:1: BThe trolls in the sunken temple have feathers strong with voodoo magics. Go there and kill Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro. Then we have magic enough for a real spirit totem.
rows.quest:8413:completion:0: It's about time this troll got a full night's rest! The spirit totem will watch over me.
rows.quest:8413:completion:1: BI been a long time collectin' things, maybe you want somethin' for all your trouble?
